gaps.sentence: ___ sun sets much later in summer.
gaps.explanation: 'The sun' — there is only one, so the definite article is used.

gaps.sentence: ___ unemployment has fallen sharply this year.
gaps.explanation: Unemployment as a general concept takes no article.

gaps.sentence: We go to ___ cinema about once a month.
gaps.explanation: 'Go to the cinema/theatre' is a fixed phrase with 'the'.

gaps.sentence: These apples cost two euros ___ kilo.
gaps.explanation: 'A/per' is used for rates: two euros a kilo, twice a week, 60 km an hour.

gaps.sentence: ___ poverty remains a serious issue worldwide.
They moved to ___ coastal town an hour south of the capital.
gaps.explanation: A coastal town — first mention of one of many.

gaps.sentence: She was elected ___ president of the students' union.
gaps.explanation: After 'elect/appoint/make + role', the article is usually dropped: elected president.

gaps.sentence: It's ___ eight o'clock news — hurry up!
gaps.explanation: 'The eight o'clock news' — a specific, known programme.
